config.calibration_A: September flights ordered by takeoff, first third
config.calibration_B: September flights ordered by takeoff, second third
config.decision_rule: Report every outcome; no method chosen or tuning performed using October; no claim of new theorem or established novelty
config.feature_availability: Compare inherited retrospective features with version excluding landed-derived flight_duration_min and remaining_to_landing_min
config.inventory: Observed labeled intervals only, not full-flight or global emissions; same-predictor imputation must equal all-point total
config.risk_calibration_C: September flights ordered by takeoff, final third
config.selection: Fixed relative half-width threshold grid plus flight-block CRC on disjoint C
config.tolerance_basis: Sensitivity benchmark only; not an aviation regulatory limit

crc.assumptions: exchangeability of flight blocks; not established under time shift
crc.target: flight-mean JOINT release and large error
